question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, and Eve are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing sweeper, Bob is playing right winger, Claire is playing benchwarmer, Dave is playing center midfielder, and Eve is playing right midfielder.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Bob and Claire trade positions. Then, Claire and Bob trade positions. Then, Alice and Eve trade positions. Then, Bob and Eve trade positions. Finally, Dave and Eve trade positions. At the end of the match, Dave is playing
Options:
(A) sweeper
(B) right winger
(C) benchwarmer
(D) center midfielder
(E) right midfielder
solution:
Positions are listed in player order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve.
Initial: sweeper, right winger, benchwarmer, center midfielder, right midfielder.
1. Bob ↔ Claire: sweeper, benchwarmer, right winger, center midfielder, right midfielder.
2. Claire ↔ Bob: sweeper, right winger, benchwarmer, center midfielder, right midfielder.
3. Alice ↔ Eve: right midfielder, right winger, benchwarmer, center midfielder, sweeper.
4. Bob ↔ Eve: right midfielder, sweeper, benchwarmer, center midfielder, right winger.
5. Dave ↔ Eve: right midfielder, sweeper, benchwarmer, right winger, center midfielder.
Dave is playing right winger, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
